title: IPC admin.endpoints.set_alias params
description: Rename an ADDED endpoint's local alias (IPC 3.0; ADR-0061 decision 7, A 2026-11-20). An alias is no wire field and keys nothing: no lease, route, trust set or overlay member moves. Whether `alias` is in the alias grammar is the METHOD's to answer (`alias_invalid`).

alias.description: The alias as the client typed or derived it, judged by the METHOD against the alias grammar `^[a-z][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$` and answered `alias_invalid` outside it; the bound here only refuses an absurd string before the method reads it.
